platform: Wild Dogs Radio Global Free Single-Song Submission Route
manual_review_reason: Wild Dogs Radio's official Music Submissions page authorizes always-free single-song submissions to office@wilddogsradio.com and requires one MP3 or WAV file, song artwork, artist or band name, song title, single or album/EP name, release year and ISRC. A human must select one suitable MarcsMusic track, verify the exact ISRC and rights, confirm current attachment-size and technical-file limits, check the unpublished AI-origin and release-recency policies, and manually send only one complete submission. The station says responses may take up to 90 days because of submission volume. Do not automate delivery, send a catalogue, use the Facebook request route as a substitute or treat donations, merchandise, promotion or advertising as submission requirements. Stop if authentication, CAPTCHA, payment, consent or other protected controls appear.
